what: The arm's properties are held by functional tests, not by reading the source. Each mutant is a one-change edit of contracts/account-evm-eip712.compact or contracts/modules/EvmEip712.compact, compiled --skip-zk in its own copy and run against the offline layer (npm run test:evm_eip712-offline: evm-eip712-offline, -grants-offline, -recovery-sim, -seam-offline and -hints-offline, the generated JavaScript in the compact-runtime simulator); the hint and display mutants also against evm-eip712-prover-dry: the prover suite's JavaScript layer (EVM_EIP712_DRY=1, no proof server) for its sections hints, texts and isolate, where a mutant that lets a refused forgery through fails that case's simulator half. A mutant is killed when a suite shows its effect: an accepted forgery (a call the unmutated copy refuses goes through) or broken honest behaviour; a suite that only reports another refusal message does not count as a kill. The unmutated copy, compiled and run the same way, passes every suite (the control).

deletedChecksLetThrough.what: for each deleted hint check, the forgeries of section isolate (and hints) that its mutant lets through: each is signed as the circuit renders the forged hint, so only that check refuses it on the unmutated copy
H1: isolate: add_device: the k256 target's x hint with a byte changed, the shown x signed, the real x executed
isolate: issue_grant: the grantee's site label hint shown as "cank.example" and signed, "bank.example" executed
isolate: activation: the key's y hint with a byte changed, the boot commitment made over the address those bytes hash to
H2: hints: device seam: a byte of the key hash outside the address
hints: device seam: a byte of the account hash outside the verifying contract
H4: isolate: remove_device: targetEpoch 1 shown and signed, 0 executed (the epoch hint of 1)
H5: isolate: rotate_enc_key: the approval made at authNonce 0, replayed at authNonce 1 with the nonce hint of 0 (its signed nonce)
isolate: remove_device: targetCounter 1 shown and signed, 0 executed (the counter hint of 1)
isolate: grantee twin: the approval made at grantNonce 0, replayed at grantNonce 1 with the nonce hint of 0 and the current spent opening
H6: isolate: withdraw_unshielded: the amount hint of 11, shown and signed, 10 executed (the label is the executed amount's)
isolate: withdraw_shielded: the change hint of 701, shown and signed, 700 executed
isolate: issue_grant: the cap hint of 1001, shown and signed, 1000 executed
H8: isolate: rotate_enc_key: the device's signature over an unrelated 32-byte value, passed as the digest hint
isolate: grantee twin: the grantee's signature over an unrelated 32-byte value, passed as the digest hint
H11: hints: add_device: a byte of a passkey target's origin
